steps.title: Research existing patterns and plan approach
steps.description: Analyze requirements for "Migrate Recipe Discovery Platform from local Postgres to Supabase". Research best practices, existing patterns, and create a technical plan.

steps.title: Copy project and update Supabase connection
steps.description: Copy the existing Recipe Discovery Platform from source project 1769685367609. Update lib/db/index.ts to add prepare: false for Supabase transaction pooler. Get the Supabase database connection string using `supabase db url --project-ref lmbrqiwzowiquebtsfyc` or construct it from project settings. Update .env.local with the Supabase DATABASE_URL (format: postgresql://postgres.[ref]:[password]@aws-0-us-east-1.pooler.supabase.com:6543/postgres). Verify the connection works.

steps.title: Push schema and migrate seed data to Supabase
steps.description: Run `npm run db:push` (or db:generate + db:migrate) to create all 9 tables and 13 indexes in Supabase. Then run `npm run db:seed` to populate seed data (2 users, 30+ ingredients, 5 dietary tags, 3 recipes with instructions). If seed script fails, use pg_dump --data-only from the source project's local Postgres and import via psql. Verify data exists: users=2, recipes=3, ingredients=30+.

steps.title: Validate app works against Supabase and clean up
steps.description: Start dev server (npm run dev) and verify: homepage loads with recipes, search/filter works, user login works (chef@example.com / password123), favorites toggle works. Update .env.example to show Supabase connection pattern. Remove any localhost:5432 references. Ensure npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors. Git commit all changes.
